protocol: grouped, eval_frac=0.3, calib_frac=0.15, folds 0/1; fit on train∪calib (the fold's training bundles); score val∪test (the other bundle) once

hypotheses.H1_artifact: Arms containing 383-430 nm bands (uniform, glw) lose their within-bundle advantage over their >=430 nm counterparts on held-out bundles.
hypotheses.H2_budget: Held-out performance of uniform430 peaks at k<=64 and is non-inferior (>= -0.01 macro-F1) to the full 256-band cube somewhere in k in [24, 64].
hypotheses.H3_method: No supervised selector beats uniform430 by more than 0.01 macro-F1 (mean of 2 folds) at k>=32 on held-out.
hypotheses.H4_brightness: The within-bundle gain from log(mu), log(sd) (gstat3) over gstat1 shrinks on held-out (illumination-confounded).
hypotheses.H5_extraction: Low-pass DCT (m=48-64) >= every selected band set of equal size on held-out.

decision_rule.inputs: within-training-bundle evidence only: a3_budget_all.json (LDA shrink 1e-3, 2 folds x 5 outer CV, nested selection) and cnn_calib.jsonl (CNN proxy, train->calib, 2 folds x 2 seeds)

R1_primary_sensor_valid_track.constraint: no band below 430 nm (pixel SNR<10, dark-clip, SNV value 85-91% explained by the global -mu/sd statistic); the global statistic may be supplied explicitly as one scalar feature (gstat1)
R1_primary_sensor_valid_track.method: glw430 if its mean paired within-train LDA CV advantage over uniform430 across k in {24,32,48,64} is >= 0.01 macro-F1, else uniform430. [Computed from a3 BEFORE freezing: glw430 - uniform430 = +0.034,+0.027,+0.011,+0.014 -> mean +0.022 -> glw430]
R1_primary_sensor_valid_track.budget: k* = smallest k on the uniform430 CNN-proxy calib curve (mean of 2 folds x 2 seeds) whose mean is >= peak - 1 SE (SE = sd over the 4 fold x seed cells / 2); budgets are read from the finest label-free curve because the budget is a property of the reading model, not the selector

decision_rule.R2_unconstrained_track: same rule over the full 383-1006 nm range (glw vs uniform) — reported for comparison, not recommended
decision_rule.use_of_heldout: test H1-H5 only and report every arm. The recommendation switches away from R1 only if H1 is falsified on BOTH proxies (artifact-including arms keep >= 0.02 mean held-out advantage over their >=430 nm counterparts); even then the implementation is 'R1 bands + explicit gstat1', which is physically valid. No arm is picked by its held-out score.
